summary: Your seventeenth Sunday review. You answer 9 questions on framing, requirements, the ladder, the framework, RAG versus fine-tuning and ADRs with a confidence number, start a decision log, extend your glossary, check that your documents still match your runs, add a written decision to your applications, tag week 17 and plan week 18.
goal: Self-test, error log (3 themes), catch-up slot, plan next week.

items.text: Self-test: answer the 9 questions with a 1 to 3 confidence number, then mark each one
Start the decision log with one line per decision
Glossary: add 8 new words with a one-line definition and an example
Run it from cold and check that every number in problem.md and the ADR is still true
Count this week's applications and add a sentence about your ADR
Run git tag week-17, then plan week 18 with an outcome sentence, a drop list and 2 or 3 applications
Play the Design Mix-up game to the end and see your score
